text:
Review complete — I read every source file, the tests, the build scripts, and the committed demo artifacts. Here's the honest assessment.

## Overall: the code is well-written, but the repo doesn't actually work as committed

The contractor writes clean Python — typed, modular, deterministic seeding, sensible separation (backend abstraction, pure vector ops, artifact I/O). If you only skim style, it looks like an 8/10. But two findings drop it hard:

**1. The pipeline cannot run: the dataset was never committed.** `config.yaml:8` points at `data/stories`, `emovec/data.py:24-45` hard-requires `data/stories/manifest.json` plus one file per (emotion, topic, story), and there is no `data/` directory anywhere in the repo — and no script to generate it either (the README says "load or generate" stories, but the generation half doesn't exist; only the prompt template survives at `data.py:8`). The committed `outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json` proves the contractor had a local 16×20×4 story corpus that never made it into the repo. Consequence: `make demo`, all three CLI commands, and the integration test `tests/test_integration_tiny.py` all fail immediately with `FileNotFoundError`. The test suite is red out of the box.

**2. The tiny-mode "validation" is circular.** `EMOTION_LEXICON` in `emovec/data.py:15-32` contains distinctive words copied verbatim from the validation `SCENARIOS` in the same file — "trail" and "snapping" for afraid, "interview"/"schedule"/"minute" for anxious, "gardener"/"rain"/"leaves" for content, "rocket" for excited, "memorial"/"daughter"/"watch" for grief. The tiny backend injects emotion vectors whenever lexicon words appear (`model.py:144-153`), so the scenario validation passes by construction, and `test_integration_tiny.py:18` asserts on that rigged outcome. A deterministic test backend is fine; hand-tuning it so the "validation" can't fail is the kind of thing you specifically asked to hear about before prod.

## Issue list

| # | Location | Sev | Description |
|---|----------|-----|-------------|
| 1 | `config.yaml:8`, `emovec/data.py:24-45` | High | Required `data/stories` corpus missing from repo and no generator script — extract/demo/tests all unrunnable |
| 2 | `tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12` | High | Integration test fails as committed (depends on missing data); CI would be red |
| 3 | `emovec/data.py:15-32` | Medium | Lexicon copies scenario-specific words, making tiny-mode validation pass by construction (circular) |
| 4 | `emovec/model.py:306-308` | Medium | Preference logit uses only the first sub-token of `" good"`/`" bad"`; multi-token encodings silently measure a fragment, and the prompt asks for a "score" while good/bad logits are read |
| 5 | `emovec/model.py:234-240` | Medium | If activity name isn't found in the prompt (`find` → −1), steering silently falls back to steering every token, including specials — changes the experiment's meaning with no warning |
| 6 | `emovec/validate_contexts.py:66-67` | Medium | When "afraid" isn't among extracted emotions, emotion index 0 is silently substituted but artifacts are still named `afraid_dosage.*` — mislabeled results |
| 7 | `emovec/extract.py:34-36` vs `extract.py:19` | Low | Token-start fallback logic duplicated in two places; will drift if one is edited |
| 8 | `config.yaml:50`, `emovec/steer_prefs.py:45-49` | Low | `min_reported_emotions` config key is dead; the 4 is hardcoded |
| 9 | `emovec/steer_prefs.py:45-49` | Low | If correlation-based selection yields <4 emotions, it silently swaps to `emotions[:4]` with no log — outputs misrepresent the method |
| 10 | `emovec/elo.py:17-19` | Low | Undocumented magic temperature (÷20) and clamp (±60); sequential pairwise Elo is order-dependent |
| 11 | `emovec/config.py:42-54` | Low | No config validation — missing sections produce empty emotion lists that fail later with a cryptic error; frozen dataclass wraps a mutable dict |
| 12 | `emovec/model.py:206-213` | Low | `dtype: auto` maps to fp32 (`torch_dtype=None`) instead of `"auto"` — a 2B model loads at full precision by default |
| 13 | `outputs/tiny_demo/**` | Low | Generated artifacts (npy/png/csv) committed; no .gitignore |
| 14 | `emovec/vector_ops.py:31` | Low | `threshold=0` still returns 1 PC; off-by-one at the boundary of "at least threshold variance" |
| 15 | `emovec/validate_contexts.py:21-24` | Low | Backend used for validation isn't checked against `manifest["backend"]`; mismatched vector/backend combos can silently produce garbage |

No security problems found — `yaml.safe_load` is used, no subprocess/eval/secret handling exists.

## Rewrite estimate

The codebase is ~1,100 lines. Most of it is keepable. What needs writing or significant change: a story-corpus generator or committed fixture set (~100 lines, new), decoupling the tiny backend's lexicon from the scenarios (~40), the preference-logit and token-position fixes (~25), and the smaller silent-fallback/config fixes (~20). Call it **~180 lines**.

## Bottom line

**No, I would not approve this as-is.** Not because the code is sloppy — it isn't — but because the deliverable is incomplete: the data the entire pipeline depends on was never checked in, the test suite fails, and the one mode that does run validates itself with leaked answers. Fix issues 1–3 and this becomes a respectable small research codebase.
